The '''Adarlon system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Minos Cluster/Legends|Minos Cluster]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]].
